entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's everything! The battery drains, the GPS is a joke, and I just don't want it anymore. I want to return it. It's that simple.
I understand your frustration. To pull up your order and check the policy details, could I please have your email address?
It's angrycustomer@email.com. Just get on with it.

Thank you. One moment while I access your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered on December 31st. Sir, I do need to inform you that according to our system, it is unfortunately too late to process a return for this item.
What?! Too late? Your website says 90 days! I've had it less than a month! Are you trying to scam me?

I can see how that would be confusing. While our apparel does have a 90-day return window, our wearable electronics that make skin contact, like the Pulse, have a different policy. The return window for that specific device is 10 days.
TEN DAYS?! That's insane! That's not enough time for anything! This is completely unacceptable. I want to speak to a manager right now!

I am the highest point of contact for this type of policy question, but I can explain the reasoning. Since the device has been in your possession for 25 days, we've passed the cutoff. The reason for this strict policy is based on health and safety, specifically our hygiene and sanitation protocols.
Hygiene? Are you kidding me? I barely wore the thing! This is a pathetic excuse to keep my money! I'm going to plaster this all over social media. VeloFit is a scam!

Sir, I understand you're upset, but this is a firm company policy designed to protect all our customers. We cannot accept wearable electronics back after this period due to sanitation risks. It is simply too late to make an exception.

I don't care about your stupid policy! This is theft! Get me your supervisor. If you don't connect me to a manager this second, I'm filing a complaint with the Better Business Bureau and my credit card company!

A supervisor will tell you the same information, as this decision is based on a non-negotiable health policy. Because it is past the 10-day window, the return cannot be approved for hygiene reasons. I am truly sorry, but my hands are tied.
Unbelievable! You've just lost a customer for life! This is the worst service I've ever received!
I regret that we couldn't find a solution for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
